name: End of Everything
detailed_description:
🧠 OVERVIEW

The world didn’t die quietly.
First came the panic. Then the rot. Then the sky split open.

In End of Everything, you and a handful of survivors fight to endure the aftermath of a planet that gave up. Cities lie hollow, nature has turned against itself, and the dead don’t stay that way. Worse still, something alien is slipping through the cracks — and it’s hunting what’s left of us.

This is a class-based, wave-driven survival shooter played from a high-angle, immersive view. You’ll face relentless hordes, gather vital supplies, and adapt on the fly in a world that’s not just ending — it’s fighting back.

Run. Shoot. Scavenge. Adapt. Repeat.
There are no safe zones here. Only temporary victories.

🔑 WHAT TO EXPECT

🎮 Tactical Angled-View Action

Tight, responsive controls put you in the heart of the chaos. Aim precisely, dodge danger, and fight smart in fast-paced, high-stakes battles.

🧟 Wave-Based Horde Survival

Face increasingly intense waves of infected, mutants, and otherworldly enemies. Each round gets harder. Each monster more unpredictable.

🧰 Choose Your Role — Classes Coming Soon

A full class system is in development to bring deeper strategy, synergy, and unique playstyles to every match.

Soon, you’ll be able to choose from specialized survivor roles — each with their own weapons, abilities, and progression paths designed to reward both solo skill and co-op teamwork.

Stay sharp. When the classes arrive, survival will never play the same way twice.

⚒️ Earn. Upgrade. Prepare.

Every kill counts. Earn currency during waves based on performance — headshots, kill streaks, support actions, and survival bonuses. Between rounds, race to randomly placed shops scattered across the battlefield.

Spend your hard-earned credits on new weapons, armor, throwables, or class-specific upgrades. Not everyone can afford everything — spend wisely, gear up fast, and get ready for the next onslaught.

🌩️ Unpredictable Battlefield Events

Adapt to chaos as meteor storms, blackout waves, and alien breaches change the rules mid-match. No two sessions play the same.

🤝 Solo or Online Co-op

Play alone or team up with up to 4 players in seamless online co-op. Revive each other, share resources, and survive together — or die alone.

🌍 WORLD AT THE END

This isn’t just another apocalypse — it’s the aftermath of extinction.
Every environment in End of Everything is handcrafted for tension and storytelling. Explore shattered cities, overrun research facilities, alien-infected wild lands, and more. Every setting reveals how the world collapsed — and how little time you have left.

short_description: The world didn’t end cleanly — it’s still trying to finish the job. In End of Everything, face relentless waves of evolving horrors in a gritty, angled-view survival shooter. Earn currency through combat, gear up at remote shops, and hold your ground in a world that refuses to stay dead.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD

content_descriptors.notes:
Apocalypse Survival Sandbox includes mature content that players should be aware of:

Violence: The game features frequent depictions of realistic violence, including blood, bodily injury, and death. Players engage in combat with zombies, alien invaders, and hostile survivors using melee and ranged weapons.

Horror Elements: Expect very frightening scenes and psychological horror, creating a tense atmosphere.

Language: There's occasional mild profanity, swearing, and cursing throughout the game, with some moderate crude language and occasional swearing.

Mature Themes: The storyline and gameplay involve survival in a harsh post-apocalyptic world, which includes environmental hazards and severe weather conditions.

Legal Drugs: The game includes implied use of alcohol or tobacco, as well as the use of alcohol or tobacco and the use of medical drugs in an unapproved manner.
